topics.title: Health system impact
topics.heading: Prevention and the health system
topics.question: How do we show that prevention changes what happens in hospitals?
topics.blurb: Waiting lists, bed days, ambulance ramping and potentially preventable hospitalisations.

topics.title: Regional environments
topics.heading: Improving regional environments for prevention
topics.question: What is already there to support healthy behaviour, and where are the gaps?
topics.blurb: Parks, active transport, green space and food environments - the surroundings that make a healthy choice easy or hard, and who is missing out.

topics.title: Prevention programs
topics.heading: Gaps in prevention programs, and what they are worth
topics.question: Where are the gaps in prevention services, and what do the programs return?
topics.blurb: What prevention is delivered where, especially through primary care, and the evidence for what it achieves.

topics.title: Regional partnerships
topics.heading: Strengthening regional partnerships
topics.question: Who does what in a region, and what would let them share data?
topics.blurb: Joint planning between health services, councils and other partners, and the data-sharing arrangements that make it possible.

topics.title: Health inequities
topics.heading: Targeting prevention to reduce health inequities
topics.question: Where should prevention effort go, so the gap between groups narrows?
topics.blurb: Differences in health between population groups and between areas, and how they are measured.

topics.title: Local government measurement
topics.heading: A prevention measurement framework for local government
topics.question: How would a council know whether its area is getting healthier?
topics.blurb: Walkability, green space, food environment and participation, measured at council level.
